description: This file defines the CountryDao class, which provides data access methods for retrieving country and province information from the database within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Data access object for country and province entities, providing methods to query country and province information from the database.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries ordered by name.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Fetches a list of provinces, optionally filtered by country code; ordered by province name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Finds and returns a country entity matching the given country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country entity based on the country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Fetches a province entity matching the specified province code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Finds and returns a province entity matching the given province name.
